skill.name: reply
skill.description: Review p11 document comments and replies, then post useful replies to visible threads that ask questions, are unclear, are indecisive, or need input. Use when Claude Code should answer reviewers on a p11 document.
skill.summary: Inspect p11 review threads and post concise replies where reviewer input is needed.
skill.author: rarexlabs

security_audit.summary: Several static hits are Markdown formatting or safe option references, but the skill does instruct agents to run the p11 CLI, read history or comments, and post replies. The highest concern is automatic installation or npx execution of @p11-core/cli@latest, plus publishing reviewer-visible replies without an explicit confirmation step.

remediation.issue: Automatic global or npx package installation
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user approval before installation, pin a trusted CLI version, and prefer a preinstalled p11 binary.
Draft each reply first and require user approval before running p11 reply on visible review threads.
Prefer explicit read URLs or IDs, ask before using p11 history, and document what comment data may be fetched.
Use stdin or a temporary reply file created by the agent, and never pass arbitrary existing paths to --body-file.

content.value_statement: Review threads can stall when questions, unclear requests, or conflicting comments lack an answer. This skill inspects visible p11 comments and posts concise replies through the p11 CLI.
actual_capabilities: Resolves a p11 target from a provided URL, ID, recent chat context, or p11 history.
Checks for the p11 CLI and recommends installation or upgrade when it is unavailable.
Fetches p11 comments and replies, with optional structured output when useful.
Identifies visible threads that need clarification, decisions, acknowledgements, or responses.
Posts concise replies with the Claude Code name, including multi-line replies through body files or stdin.
limitations: Requires a working p11 CLI, network access, and any needed p11 authentication.
Only considers comments and replies that are visible to reviewers.
Does not revise document content; settled change requests belong in p11:revise.
May need user confirmation for sensitive replies or ambiguous document targets.

use_cases.title: Answer Reviewer Questions
use_cases.description: Review visible p11 comments and respond when reviewers need direct answers or missing context.

use_cases.title: Clarify Open Decisions
use_cases.description: Find indecisive or conflicting threads and post a concise question or decision prompt.

use_cases.title: Triage Before Revision
use_cases.description: Separate threads that need replies from settled requests that should move to revision work.

prompt_templates.title: Review One Document
prompt_templates.prompt: Use p11:reply on this p11 read URL and reply only to visible threads that need an answer: <url>

prompt_templates.title: Reply From Chat Context
prompt_templates.prompt: Use p11:reply for the most recent p11 document in this chat. Summarize threads that do not need replies.

prompt_templates.title: Clarify Ambiguous Feedback
prompt_templates.prompt: Use p11:reply to find comments with unclear requests. Ask one direct clarifying question for each thread that blocks revision.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Safe Replies
prompt_templates.prompt: Use p11:reply on this target, draft each proposed reply first, and wait for my approval before posting: <target>

output_examples.input: A reviewer asks whether the launch date should be final or marked tentative.
output_examples.output: Posted a concise reply asking for the final launch date decision and noting that revision can proceed after confirmation.

output_examples.input: Several visible comments request direct wording changes.
output_examples.output: No replies were needed. The comments contain settled edits that should be handled through the revision workflow.

output_examples.input: Two reviewers give conflicting guidance on the same section.
output_examples.output: Posted a reply that names the conflict and asks which direction should control the next revision.

best_practices: Provide a p11 read URL or ID when possible.
Review proposed replies before posting when comments involve policy, legal, or customer commitments.
Use concise reply text that answers the thread and names any needed decision.
anti_patterns: Using p11 history when the current chat already has a clear target.
Replying to every unresolved thread without checking whether it needs a response.
Posting replies for settled edit requests that should be handled by p11:revise.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It reviews visible p11 comment threads and posts replies when a response is useful.

faq.question: Does it edit the document?
faq.answer: No. It only reviews comments and posts replies; document edits should use p11:revise.

faq.question: Can it use an edit URL?
faq.answer: Yes. It can recover the matching read target from context, comments, or history when needed.

faq.question: Will it reply to resolved or hidden comments?
faq.answer: No. The instructions limit replies to comments visible to reviewers.

faq.question: Does it need the p11 CLI?
faq.answer: Yes. It depends on the p11 CLI and may require installation, updates, or authentication.

faq.question: Should I approve replies before posting?
faq.answer: Approval is recommended for sensitive topics, ambiguous targets, or comments with business commitments.
